entity_raw.definition_raw: Feather SubdomainSource Advanced Player's Guide pg. 1Associated Domain(s): AnimalAssociated Deities: Aldinach, Cernunnos, Daclau-Sar, Easivra, Erastil, Horus, Ketephys, Losarkur, Morrobahn, Neith, Rasvocel, Shub-Niggurath, Tanagaar, Tjasse, Uskyeria, YlimanchaReplacement Power: Add Fly to your list of class skills. In addition, whenever you cast a spell that grants you a fly speed, your maneuverability increases by one step (up to perfect).The following granted power replaces the speak with animals power of the Animal domain. Eyes of the Hawk (Ex): You gain a racial bonus on Perception checks equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum +1). In addition, if you can act during a surprise round, you receive a +2 racial bonus on your Initiative check.Replacement Domain Spells: 2nd—feather fall, 3rd—fly, 6th—fly (mass).
